name: lightning-target-acquisition
intent: A loose reticle snaps onto a fixed target; three branch-bolts flicker at frozen angles, then status LOCKED.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Reticle resolves directly to LOCKED; no snap or bolt flicker

acceptance: Reticle starts at approachOffsetPx [-92,-58] and snaps onto target in snapMs 440
Exactly 3 branch-bolts at boltDeg [18,-24,8] flicker for flickerMs 180 starting at flickerAtMs 300
After settleMs 150 status reads LOCKED and bolts are gone
Replay resets to IDLE offset before re-acquiring
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows LOCKED immediately with animations disabled
